component.name: BlockLiner
component.summary: Software architecture diagrams, saved as Mermaid

description.p: BlockLiner draws software component and architecture diagrams: boxes, rounded boxes, lines, arrows and labels that snap to a grid. Each diagram is a Mermaid flowchart in a folder you choose, readable and diffable as text, with the layout kept in Mermaid comments.

ul.li: Shapes, connectors that stay glued to their shapes, and free lines
Undo and redo, keyboard nudging and a command palette
Autosave, and plain Mermaid files laid out automatically on opening
Export to PNG or SVG, all objects or only the selected ones
